event.vf.intro.line1: Good morning! Your crops look healthy. I was hoping you could help me with something.
event.vf.intro.line2: I want to try stacking two soil trays on a wooden frame. Think we could grow parsnips in them?
event.vf.intro.line3: The bottom tray might be too dark. And the frame has to hold all that wet soil.
event.vf.intro.line4: Robin looked over the sketch. She can build it. I still need someone to try growing crops in it.
event.vf.intro.line5: We'll need a small lab. Last time I brought a soil tray into the house, Robin made me scrub the floor.
event.vf.intro.line6: Robin has the building plans. Once the lab is ready, take a look at the research desk inside.

dialogue.vf.submit.demetrius: That should be enough. Let me take a look.
dialogue.vf.submit.maru: Got them! Leave the parts here. Where did I put my tools?
dialogue.vf.submit.robin: These will do. Leave them over there.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s1.start: I want to start with the frame. Wet soil is heavy. We should check how much it can hold.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s1.done: That's all the wood and stone. We can start on the trays.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s2.start: We need soil that will stay put around the roots. Let's try clay and fiber.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s2.done: The trays are holding the soil. Let's try parsnips next.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s3.start: Parsnips grow quickly. We'll not have to wait long for a result.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s3.done: New leaves. I still want to check the light in the bottom tray.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s4.start: A copper sheet could reflect light into the bottom tray. I sketched a bracket. It should fit.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s4.done: There we go. Careful with that copper edge. It's sharp.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s5.start: Go ahead and pull the parsnips. I want to see whether the roots are crowded.
dialogue.vf.rack2.s5.done: The roots look healthy. The two-tier plans are ready for you to use.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s1.start: Another tray? All right. The base needs to be wider too. Bring me the lumber.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s1.done: That's enough. I'll add a couple more braces this time.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s2.start: The middle tray could end up in the shade. Let's try a reflector with cloth and quartz.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s2.done: The reflector fits. Maru can measure the light.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s3.start: I left the light readings on the desk. I need a battery pack for another check.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s3.done: There's the reading! The middle tray is much brighter now.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s4.start: The pipe needs to run along the post or it will catch on the leaves. Clay should seal the joints.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s4.done: No leaks. I can finally put this bucket down.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s5.start: Try cauliflower. Those leaves could shade the bottom tray once they spread.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s5.done: The leaves have opened, and light still reaches the tray below.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s6.start: Let me see the harvest. Demetrius wants a sample too.
dialogue.vf.rack3.s6.done: No sagging, no leaning. Here are the three-tier plans. Follow these and you'll be fine.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s1.start: At this height, ordinary wood won't do. We need hardwood posts.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s1.done: These posts will hold. I'll leave the water pipes to those two.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s2.start: We need water in the top tray. There are a few sketches on the desk. Pick one.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s2.done: All right. We'll try that water supply.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s3.start: Melons are heavy. Let's see whether the rack holds until harvest.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s3.done: The fruit's growing. The crossbeam is still straight.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s4.start: This crossbeam wobbles. I want to tie it down with a cloth strap.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s4.done: Much better. Leave that strap alone. I just tied it.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s5.start: The light is fitted. I need to check the old notes before I connect the battery.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s5.done: It lights up! Even the bottom tray gets some light.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s6.start: The fruit's still growing. Pick it when it's ripe. I want to check the crossbeam afterward.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s6.done: The melons are in. Leave the rack there. Robin wants to look it over.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s7.start: Finished picking? Let me tighten these joints. We need the last batch of materials too.
dialogue.vf.rack4.s7.done: Done. Here are the four-tier plans. Don't skimp on the hardwood posts.
dialogue.vf.crop.s1.start: Bring some samples first. I want to look at the roots and fruit.
dialogue.vf.crop.s1.done: The samples are ready. We can try the trays.
dialogue.vf.crop.s2.start: Check the trays first. A few edges need work.
dialogue.vf.crop.s2.done: That should be ready for planting. Give it a try.
dialogue.vf.crop.s3.start: Plant it on the trial rack. I want to see the new leaves.
dialogue.vf.crop.s3.done: It's growing. Leave this plant in place for now.
dialogue.vf.crop.s4.start: Let me know when you harvest. I want to make a few notes.
dialogue.vf.crop.s4.done: I have recorded the harvest. This crop can go on planting racks.
dialogue.vf.crop.s5.start: Check the support before you pick the fruit.
dialogue.vf.crop.s5.done: The support is still straight. You can pick it now.
dialogue.vf.crop.s6.start: Save a good specimen for me.
dialogue.vf.crop.s6.done: Good fruit. That finishes the notes.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s1.start: Starfruit needs plenty of light. Bring a few over so I can look at the fruit.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s1.done: I have the samples. Let's try growing it.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s2.start: Plant it on the trial rack. I haven't seen it grow in a soil tray before.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s2.done: It's planted. Let's wait for new leaves.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s3.start: I want to look at the new leaves. The tray soil needs some more fiber too.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s3.done: The new leaves have opened. Let's check the light in the bottom tray.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s4.start: There are a few ways to add light in the notes. Choose one to try.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s4.done: We'll try that one. Maru can help fit it.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s5.start: The sketch is ready! I still need iron for the joints and cloth around the light.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s5.done: All the parts are here. I don't want to hunt for tiny screws on the floor again.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s6.start: It's fitted. Don't pick anything yet. I want another look at the leaves.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s6.done: The leaves have grown, and the light bracket is holding.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s7.start: The fruit needs a little longer. Keep a battery pack for the light.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s7.done: Ripe at last. You can pick the starfruit now.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s8.start: Save a starfruit for me. Don't sell the whole harvest.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s8.done: The flesh looks healthy. I'll keep this one as a specimen.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s9.start: I need a few more samples, then I can file these notes.
dialogue.vf.starfruit.s9.done: That completes the notes. You can grow starfruit on planting racks now.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s1.start: Ancient fruit? Let me see. I think there are notes about it in the cabinet.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s1.done: I have the samples. I'll look through the old notebook.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s2.start: The old notes are a little vague. We'll have to try it ourselves.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s2.done: We have the materials. Maru is working out how to start more plants.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s3.start: I have a few ideas for starting more plants. The sketches are on the desk. See what you think.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s3.done: All right, that one. I'll get the tools ready.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s4.start: Plant it on the four-tier trial rack. Give it time. This crop grows slowly.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s4.done: It's planted. Leave it there for now.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s5.start: The new leaves haven't opened yet. Keep the iridium parts ready.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s5.done: New leaves. The roots are staying inside the tray too.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s6.start: This tray edge is loose. I want to add some cloth and check it again.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s6.done: There. The readings have stopped jumping around.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s7.start: The fruit needs more time. Check the rack, but be careful around the new shoots.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s7.done: The fruit's ripe. You can pick the first harvest.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s8.start: Pick the fruit and leave the plant. It can keep producing.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s8.done: That's the first harvest. Don't dig up the plant.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s9.start: Bring a good fruit over. I want to weigh it, and the battery is nearly flat.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s9.done: Weighed it! I wrote the number in the notes on the desk.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s10.start: Keep the last samples for me. The notes can go in the cabinet now.
dialogue.vf.ancient.s10.done: The notes are filed. Ancient fruit can grow on planting racks too. Keep that plant.

dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s1.start: Bring a few parsnips. I want to measure the roots.
dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s1.done: That should be enough. The roots ought to fit in the trays.
dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s2.start: Plant parsnips on the trial rack. We'll see how much room the roots need.
dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s2.done: New leaves. Let it ripen before we pull it.
dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s3.start: Watch the root tips when you pull them. Leave a little soil on them for me.
dialogue.vf.crop.parsnip.s3.done: The roots are straight. Parsnips can grow on planting racks.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s1.start: Bring a few potatoes. I want to look at their sizes.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s1.done: About this size, then. We should leave some extra room in the tray.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s2.start: Plant the potatoes. Don't pack the tray soil too tightly.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s2.done: They are growing. Leave the soil underneath alone for now.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s3.start: Take a careful look when you harvest. I want to see whether there are small potatoes around the edges.
dialogue.vf.crop.potato.s3.done: We have potatoes, and the tray hasn't split. You can use this method.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s1.start: Cauliflower has broad leaves. Bring a few so I can measure them.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s1.done: The leaves are wider than the tray. We'll need to watch the crop below.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s2.start: Bring some cloth. I want to hang it beside the rack and check the shade.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s2.done: The cloth is up. Now we can try growing cauliflower.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s3.start: Plant it. We can look at the bottom tray once the leaves open.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s3.done: The leaves are open. Light still reaches the tray below.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s4.start: Save one for me when you harvest. Keep the leaves too.
dialogue.vf.crop.cauliflower.s4.done: Healthy cauliflower. It can grow on planting racks too.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s1.start: Bring some strawberries. I also want to look at the new shoots.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s1.done: I have the samples. We should tidy up the tray edges.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s2.start: Put some fiber around the tray edges so the shoots don't hang over them.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s2.done: The edges are ready. Go ahead and plant strawberries.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s3.start: Let strawberries grow on the trial rack for a while. I want to check the edges.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s3.done: The shoots are staying in the tray, and the fruit's growing.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s4.start: Pick this harvest. Leave the plants in place. Don't pull up the roots.
dialogue.vf.crop.strawberry.s4.done: I have the strawberries. We can use this method. Leave the plants for another harvest.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s1.start: Blueberry branches can crowd each other. Bring some fruit for me to look at first.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s1.done: That's enough. Maru wants to try reflecting light between the branches.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s2.start: I want to put a quartz reflector here. It should let more light between the branches.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s2.done: It's fitted! Leave that screw alone. It took me ages to tighten it.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s3.start: Plant the blueberries. We can look inside once the branches spread.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s3.done: The branches have spread, and light still gets between them.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s4.start: Pick some blueberries. Save a few of the small ones too.
dialogue.vf.crop.blueberry.s4.done: These blueberries look healthy. The rack growing notes are ready.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s1.start: Bring a few melons so I can weigh them. The rack has to carry all of them.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s1.done: Heavier than this stone. We need something to hold them up.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s2.start: Bring cloth and clay. I want to try a support with softer padding.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s2.done: That should be enough for the supports. Take a look at Maru's sketches.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s3.start: I sketched wooden cradles and cloth slings. Which looks easier to fit?
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s3.done: All right, we'll use that one. Try not to drop a melon on your foot.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s4.start: Plant the melons. Keep the supports ready before the fruit starts hanging down.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s4.done: The fruit's growing. Check the supports.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s5.start: The fruit's getting heavier. We need iron under the supports.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s5.done: The supports are straight. Now we can wait for ripe melons.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s6.start: Save a good melon when you harvest. I want to look at the flesh.
dialogue.vf.crop.melon.s6.done: The flesh looks healthy. Melons can grow on racks. Remember the fruit supports.

research.vf.balance.prepare.name: Trial preparations
research.vf.balance.observe.name: Watch the seedlings
research.vf.balance.observe.objective: Plant on a prototype rack and watch the seedlings.
research.vf.balance.finish.name: Trial notes
research.vf.balance.finish.objective: Check the results at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.balance.prepare.done: The trial pots are ready. Bring your seeds.
dialogue.vf.balance.prepare.robin.done: The pots are steady. Bring your seeds.
dialogue.vf.balance.prepare.maru.done: The trial pots are ready. Bring some seeds next time.
dialogue.vf.balance.finish.start: The notes are on the desk. I'll check them once more.

research.vf.balance.cauliflower.name: Cauliflower
research.vf.balance.cauliflower.descript: Trial notes for growing cauliflower on a rack.
Leave the cauliflower head for later. I want to see how the roots take to the pot.
Don't fill the pot to the brim. Leave the roots some room.
The seedlings are upright. The roots aren't crowded, either.
dialogue.vf.balance.cauliflower.finish.d: That'll do. The heads will take a while, but the rack is ready.
research.vf.balance.garlic.name: Garlic
research.vf.balance.garlic.description: Trial notes for growing garlic on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.garlic.prepare.start: Garlic won't need a big pot. Let's use a small one.
dialogue.vf.balance.garlic.observe.start: Keep the soil loose. The garlic needs room to spread.
dialogue.vf.balance.garlic.observe.done: New leaves. The roots have a good hold.
dialogue.vf.balance.garlic.finish.done: Here's your copy. You can grow garlic on the rack now.
research.vf.balance.kale.name: Kale
research.vf.balance.kale.description: Trial notes for growing kale on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.kale.prepare.start: Kale leaves get crowded. Let's give them a little room.
dialogue.vf.balance.kale.observe.start: Watch the plants in the middle. Keep their leaves clear of the rim.
dialogue.vf.balance.kale.observe.done: Hm. The leaves aren't getting crowded.
dialogue.vf.balance.kale.finish.done: I've written up the kale notes. Here you go.
research.vf.balance.rhubarb.name: Rhubarb
research.vf.balance.rhubarb.description: Trial notes for growing rhubarb on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.rhubarb.prepare.star: Rhubarb stalks need space. Let's check the width of the pots.
dialogue.vf.balance.rhubarb.observe.star: Leave the pots there. I want to see which way the leaves spread.
dialogue.vf.balance.rhubarb.observe.done: The stalks have room to spread.
dialogue.vf.balance.rhubarb.finish.done: Use this plan. Harvest is still a way off; the rack is ready.
research.vf.balance.melon.name: Melon
research.vf.balance.melon.description: Trial notes for growing melon on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.melon.prepare.start: Those melon pots need a firm base. Let's start underneath.
dialogue.vf.balance.melon.observe.start: The supports are nailed down. Plant away. Keep your boots off them!
dialogue.vf.balance.melon.observe.done: The boards are level, and the seedlings are up.
dialogue.vf.balance.melon.finish.done: Here's the plan. There's room for the pots as the melons grow.
research.vf.balance.tomato.name: Tomato
research.vf.balance.tomato.description: Trial notes for growing tomato on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.tomato.prepare.start: Tomatoes spread out. The supports could use a wider edge.
dialogue.vf.balance.tomato.observe.start: The side supports are in. Now let's see how the seedlings do.
dialogue.vf.balance.tomato.observe.done: The seedlings are upright. The supports are steady, too.
dialogue.vf.balance.tomato.finish.done: The tomato plan is ready. You can put them on the rack.
research.vf.balance.blueberry.name: Blueberry
research.vf.balance.blueberry.descriptio: Trial notes for growing blueberry on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.blueberry.prepare.st: New leaves will tell us enough about the blueberries. No need to pick fruit yet.
dialogue.vf.balance.blueberry.observe.st: Water the upper pot too. I want to compare the new leaves.
dialogue.vf.balance.blueberry.observe.do: Both pots have new leaves. Their color looks much the same.
dialogue.vf.balance.blueberry.finish.don: The notes are ready. Use this plan for the blueberries.
research.vf.balance.hotpepper.name: Hot Pepper
research.vf.balance.hotpepper.descriptio: Trial notes for growing hot pepper on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.hotpepper.prepare.st: Peppers grow quickly. Let's look at the seedlings first.
dialogue.vf.balance.hotpepper.observe.st: Put the pot here. Keep the leaves clear of its neighbor.
dialogue.vf.balance.hotpepper.observe.do: The leaves have spread out. They aren't crowded.
dialogue.vf.balance.hotpepper.finish.don: Here's the pepper plan. Don't rub your eyes after picking them.
research.vf.balance.hotpepper.wait: Wait for young hot pepper leaves.
research.vf.balance.wheat.name: Wheat
research.vf.balance.wheat.description: Trial notes for growing wheat on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.wheat.prepare.start: Wheat fills out fast. Leave some space by the rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.wheat.observe.start: The frame is in. I'll check it again once the seedlings are up.
dialogue.vf.balance.wheat.observe.done: The seedlings are even. The frame isn't in their way.
dialogue.vf.balance.wheat.finish.done: I've left room for cutting on the plan. Wheat is ready for the rack.
research.vf.balance.radish.name: Radish
research.vf.balance.radish.description: Trial notes for growing radish on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.radish.prepare.start: Radishes need a deep pot. Keep the bottom lining thin.
dialogue.vf.balance.radish.observe.start: I've left a small opening to watch the roots. Keep it clear.
dialogue.vf.balance.radish.observe.done: The new roots are growing down. They haven't reached the bottom.
dialogue.vf.balance.radish.finish.done: That's deep enough. Here are your radish notes.
research.vf.balance.redcabbage.name: Red Cabbage
research.vf.balance.redcabbage.descripti: Trial notes for growing red cabbage on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.redcabbage.prepare.s: Red cabbage leaves spread out. Let's try the spacing between the pots.
dialogue.vf.balance.redcabbage.observe.s: Leave a gap in the middle. We can check it as the leaves grow.
dialogue.vf.balance.redcabbage.observe.d: The leaves aren't touching the next pot.
dialogue.vf.balance.redcabbage.finish.do: The spacing is written down. Use this plan for red cabbage.
research.vf.balance.redcabbage.wait: Wait for young red cabbage leaves.
research.vf.balance.starfruit.name: Starfruit
research.vf.balance.starfruit.descriptio: Trial notes for growing starfruit on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.starfruit.prepare.st: We don't have to wait for starfruit. I'll check the light around the seedlings.#Prepare three Starfruit Seeds for the three-layer trial rack. We only observe the young plants. Once no other study needs them, they are removed without returning seeds or waiting for fruit.
dialogue.vf.balance.starfruit.observe.st: The light is in place. Mind that wire when you water.
dialogue.vf.balance.starfruit.observe.do: The lower shelf gets light too. The seedlings aren't yellowing.
dialogue.vf.balance.starfruit.finish.don: The starfruit trial notes are ready. This copy is yours.
research.vf.balance.starfruit.wait: Wait for the starfruit to sprout.
research.vf.balance.pineapple.name: Pineapple
research.vf.balance.pineapple.descriptio: Trial notes for growing pineapple on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.pineapple.prepare.st: Pineapple leaves are prickly. Let's space the pots out.
dialogue.vf.balance.pineapple.observe.st: Keep the leaves clear of the wooden beam.
dialogue.vf.balance.pineapple.observe.do: The new leaves have room to grow.
dialogue.vf.balance.pineapple.finish.don: Here's the pineapple plan. Wear gloves when you move the pots.
research.vf.balance.coffeebean.name: Coffee Bean
research.vf.balance.coffeebean.descripti: Trial notes for growing coffee bean on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.coffeebean.prepare.s: We can try coffee beans too. I want to check the leaves on the upper shelf.
dialogue.vf.balance.coffeebean.observe.s: The pots are in place. Leave them there while I check the light.
dialogue.vf.balance.coffeebean.observe.d: The new leaves look green. The upper shelf is getting light.
dialogue.vf.balance.coffeebean.finish.do: The coffee plan is ready. Please don't roast beans on the research desk.
research.vf.balance.coffeebean.wait: Wait for young coffee bean leaves.
research.vf.balance.cactusfruit.name: Cactus Fruit
research.vf.balance.cactusfruit.descript: Trial notes for growing cactus fruit on a rack.
Cactus pots need drainage. We can't leave them sitting in water.
The bottom lining is ready. Let's check the new roots after watering.
The pots aren't holding water at the bottom. The roots are growing.
dialogue.vf.balance.cactusfruit.finish.d: The rack is ready for cactus fruit. Watch those spines.
research.vf.balance.cactusfruit.wait: Wait for young cactus fruit leaves.
research.vf.balance.corn.name: Corn
research.vf.balance.corn.description: Trial notes for growing corn on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.corn.prepare.start: Corn grows tall. Those pots need solid supports.
dialogue.vf.balance.corn.observe.start: It's nailed down. Let's see if the seedlings stand straight.
dialogue.vf.balance.corn.observe.done: The pots are steady and the seedlings are upright.
dialogue.vf.balance.corn.finish.done: The corn notes are ready. Build the rack like this.
research.vf.balance.corn.wait: Wait for the corn to sprout.
research.vf.balance.amaranth.name: Amaranth
research.vf.balance.amaranth.description: Trial notes for growing amaranth on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.amaranth.prepare.sta: Amaranth needs a little room for cutting.
dialogue.vf.balance.amaranth.observe.sta: I've left a gap here. You plant it; I'll watch the supports.
dialogue.vf.balance.amaranth.observe.don: The supports are steady. The seedlings are up too.
dialogue.vf.balance.amaranth.finish.done: Amaranth is ready. Keep that gap open.
research.vf.balance.eggplant.name: Eggplant
research.vf.balance.eggplant.description: Trial notes for growing eggplant on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.eggplant.prepare.sta: Don't crowd the eggplant pots. I want to watch the new leaves.
dialogue.vf.balance.eggplant.observe.sta: Face the leaves on these pots outward.
dialogue.vf.balance.eggplant.observe.don: The new leaves have opened. They aren't shading the shelf below.
dialogue.vf.balance.eggplant.finish.done: Use this plan for eggplants. The pot positions are marked here.
research.vf.balance.artichoke.name: Artichoke
research.vf.balance.artichoke.descriptio: Trial notes for growing artichoke on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.artichoke.prepare.st: Artichoke leaves need space. Let's start with a pot.
dialogue.vf.balance.artichoke.observe.st: Put the pot on the mark. Don't move it further in.
dialogue.vf.balance.artichoke.observe.do: The young leaves have opened. The beam isn't in the way.
dialogue.vf.balance.artichoke.finish.don: Use this spacing for the artichoke pots. Here you go.
research.vf.balance.pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
research.vf.balance.pumpkin.description: Trial notes for growing pumpkin on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.pumpkin.prepare.star: Pumpkin pots get heavy. I'll use thicker support boards.
dialogue.vf.balance.pumpkin.observe.star: The boards are replaced. Go ahead and plant. Keep the pots away from the edge.
dialogue.vf.balance.pumpkin.observe.done: The boards are straight and the seedlings are upright.
dialogue.vf.balance.pumpkin.finish.done: Here's the pumpkin plan. Use the thick board underneath.
research.vf.balance.bokchoy.name: Bok Choy
research.vf.balance.bokchoy.description: Trial notes for growing bok choy on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.bokchoy.prepare.star: Bok choy is compact. Let's check the roots in the pot.
dialogue.vf.balance.bokchoy.observe.star: Leave some loose soil for the new roots.
dialogue.vf.balance.bokchoy.observe.done: The roots have taken hold. The leaves have opened too.
dialogue.vf.balance.bokchoy.finish.done: The bok choy notes are ready. Use pots this deep.
research.vf.balance.bokchoy.wait: Wait for young bok choy leaves.
research.vf.balance.yam.name: Yam
research.vf.balance.yam.description: Trial notes for growing yam on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.yam.prepare.start: Yams grow under the soil. We should watch the bottom of the pot.
dialogue.vf.balance.yam.observe.start: Watch which way the roots grow. Don't dig it up yet.
dialogue.vf.balance.yam.observe.done: The roots are growing down. There's room left in the pot.
dialogue.vf.balance.yam.finish.done: I've noted the depth. You can grow more yams on the rack now.
research.vf.balance.cranberries.name: Cranberries
research.vf.balance.cranberries.descript: Trial notes for growing cranberries on a rack.
Cranberry stems get crowded. Space the pots out first.
Watch the plant by the beam. Keep its leaves clear.
The new leaves are out. They aren't crowded under the beam.
dialogue.vf.balance.cranberries.finish.d: Here's the cranberry plan. Leave space between the pots.
research.vf.balance.beet.name: Beet
research.vf.balance.beet.description: Trial notes for growing beet on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.beet.prepare.start: We can start with the beet roots. Don't pull them up yet.
dialogue.vf.balance.beet.observe.start: There's an opening in the pot. Take a look underneath.
dialogue.vf.balance.beet.observe.done: The roots have taken hold. They aren't pressing against the bottom.
dialogue.vf.balance.beet.finish.done: The beet notes are ready. Here you go.
research.vf.balance.ancientfruit.name: Ancient Fruit
research.vf.balance.ancientfruit.descrip: Trial notes for growing ancient fruit on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.ancientfruit.prepare: Ancient seeds? Leave the packet closed. I'll get the trial pots.#This trial needs four Ancient Seeds on the four-layer rack. We only observe the young plants. Once no other study needs them, they are removed without returning seeds or waiting for fruit.
dialogue.vf.balance.ancientfruit.observe: Let's see if it sprouts. Fruit can wait.
It's sprouted. There's no water sitting in the pots, either.
The sprouting notes are enough. Use this plan for ancient fruit.
research.vf.balance.ancientfruit.wait: Wait for the ancient fruit to sprout.
research.vf.balance.tulip.name: Tulip
research.vf.balance.tulip.description: Trial notes for growing tulip on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.tulip.prepare.start: Tulip pots can go at the edge. Easier to see the flowers there.
dialogue.vf.balance.tulip.observe.start: The supports are in. The seeds are your department.
dialogue.vf.balance.tulip.observe.done: The seedlings are up. The pots are sitting firmly.
dialogue.vf.balance.tulip.finish.done: The tulip plan is ready. I'll come look when they bloom.
research.vf.balance.bluejazz.name: Blue Jazz
research.vf.balance.bluejazz.description: Trial notes for growing blue jazz on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.bluejazz.prepare.sta: Blue jazz flowers are small. Let's try the little pots.
dialogue.vf.balance.bluejazz.observe.sta: Plant in these pots. We can start with the new leaves.
dialogue.vf.balance.bluejazz.observe.don: The new leaves are even. The little pots have enough room.
dialogue.vf.balance.bluejazz.finish.done: Here's the blue jazz plan. I've marked the small pots on it.
research.vf.balance.bluejazz.wait: Wait for young blue jazz leaves.
research.vf.balance.poppy.name: Poppy
research.vf.balance.poppy.description: Trial notes for growing poppy on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.poppy.prepare.start: Poppy roots are small. Keep the soil loose.
dialogue.vf.balance.poppy.observe.start: Once they're planted, leave the pots in place.
dialogue.vf.balance.poppy.observe.done: The seedlings are up and the roots have taken hold.
dialogue.vf.balance.poppy.finish.done: The rack is ready for poppies. Now we wait for the flowers.
research.vf.balance.summerspangle.name: Summer Spangle
research.vf.balance.summerspangle.descri: Trial notes for growing summer spangle on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.summerspangle.prepar: Summer spangle leaves are broad. Let's check the light below them.
dialogue.vf.balance.summerspangle.observ: I've put a little light below. Let's start with the seedlings.
The leaves aren't blocking the light below.
dialogue.vf.balance.summerspangle.finish: The summer spangle notes are ready. Here you go.
research.vf.balance.summerspangle.wait: Wait for young summer spangle leaves.
research.vf.balance.sunflower.name: Sunflower
research.vf.balance.sunflower.descriptio: Trial notes for growing sunflower on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.sunflower.prepare.st: Sunflowers grow tall. Let's use wider supports.
dialogue.vf.balance.sunflower.observe.st: The wide boards are in. Your turn to plant.
dialogue.vf.balance.sunflower.observe.do: The seedlings are upright. The pots aren't wobbling.
dialogue.vf.balance.sunflower.finish.don: Use this plan for sunflowers. Keep the wide supports.
research.vf.balance.fairyrose.name: Fairy Rose
research.vf.balance.fairyrose.descriptio: Trial notes for growing fairy rose on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.fairyrose.prepare.st: Fairy roses take a while to bloom. Let's check the young leaves first.
dialogue.vf.balance.fairyrose.observe.st: There's light on both shelves. Let's try planting them.
dialogue.vf.balance.fairyrose.observe.do: The young leaves are out on the lower shelf too.
dialogue.vf.balance.fairyrose.finish.don: The fairy rose notes are ready. You don't have to wait here for flowers.
research.vf.balance.fairyrose.wait: Wait for the fairy rose to sprout.
research.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.name: Sweet Gem Berry
research.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.descri: Trial notes for growing sweet gem berry on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.prepar: Keep the rare seeds for planting. I'll use the seedlings to study the roots.#Prepare two Rare Seeds for the two-layer trial rack. We only observe the young plants. Once no other study needs them, they are removed without returning seeds or waiting for fruit.
dialogue.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.observ: We'll start with the sprouts. Leave the seedlings in the pots.
They've sprouted. The roots aren't crowded.
dialogue.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.finish: The sweet gem berry notes are ready. This copy is yours.
research.vf.balance.sweetgemberry.wait: Wait for the sweet gem berry to sprout.
research.vf.balance.carrot.name: Carrot
research.vf.balance.carrot.description: Trial notes for growing carrot on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.carrot.prepare.start: Carrots grow quickly. Let's start with the new roots.
dialogue.vf.balance.carrot.observe.start: Loosen the soil and leave some room at the bottom.
dialogue.vf.balance.carrot.observe.done: The roots are growing down. This pot is deep enough.
dialogue.vf.balance.carrot.finish.done: Here's the carrot plan. Use pots this deep.
research.vf.balance.summersquash.name: Summer Squash
research.vf.balance.summersquash.descrip: Trial notes for growing summer squash on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.summersquash.prepare: Summer squash pots need a steady base. The stems spread out.
dialogue.vf.balance.summersquash.observe: I've widened the board a little. Go ahead and plant.
The stems have room to grow. The pots are level.
The summer squash plan is ready. Keep that extra length of board.
research.vf.balance.summersquash.wait: Wait for young summer squash leaves.
research.vf.balance.broccoli.name: Broccoli
research.vf.balance.broccoli.description: Trial notes for growing broccoli on a rack.
dialogue.vf.balance.broccoli.prepare.sta: Let's start with broccoli leaves. They'll show us if the pots are crowded.
dialogue.vf.balance.broccoli.observe.sta: Leave a gap in the middle. I'll measure it once the new leaves are out.
dialogue.vf.balance.broccoli.observe.don: The leaves are clear of the next pot. That's enough space.
dialogue.vf.balance.broccoli.finish.done: The broccoli spacing is written down. Here you go.
research.vf.balance.powdermelon.name: Powdermelon
research.vf.balance.powdermelon.descript: Trial notes for growing powdermelon on a rack.
Powdermelon pots need support. I'll fit the board underneath.
The support is ready. Plant away. We'll start with the seedlings.
The seedlings are even and the support is level.
dialogue.vf.balance.powdermelon.finish.d: Here's the powdermelon plan. The rack works in winter too.

research.vf.hydroponics.name: Soilless growing
research.vf.hydroponics.description: Try growing without soil. Start with a few ceramic troughs.
research.vf.hydroponics.s1.name: Make the troughs
research.vf.hydroponics.s1.objective: Bring clay, refined quartz and fiber to the sample station.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s1.start: Want to replace the soil with water? First we need a trough that holds it.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s1.done: That will do. I will fire the troughs.
research.vf.hydroponics.s2.name: Fit a return pipe
research.vf.hydroponics.s2.objective: Choose a return pipe, then inspect a prototype rack.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s2.start: The pipe goes on this side. Iron or clay?
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s2.done: Connected. Let us run some water.
research.vf.hydroponics.s3.name: Test the roots
research.vf.hydroponics.s3.objective: Plant parsnips on the soilless prototype rack, water them and watch for a sprout.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s3.start: That rack has water troughs. Try some parsnips. Remember to water them.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s3.done: Sprouts. The roots seem fine in the water.
research.vf.hydroponics.s4.name: Fit the troughs
research.vf.hydroponics.s4.objective: Collect the soilless rack plans at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s4.start: Good, the troughs do not leak. I will use the usual rack frames.
dialogue.vf.hydroponics.s4.done: Here. Make as many tiers as you know how to build.
research.vf.shed.name: Shed heating
research.vf.shed.description: Try a coal stove with a clay liner to keep a shed warm overnight.
research.vf.shed.s1.name: A small stove
research.vf.shed.s1.objective: Submit coal and clay for a test stove.
dialogue.vf.shed.s1.start: Sealing the door is not enough. Let us try a little stove.
dialogue.vf.shed.s1.done: The liner is ready. Careful, it is still hot.
research.vf.shed.s2.name: Feed the stove
research.vf.shed.s2.objective: Submit a little more coal, then check the temperature at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.shed.s2.start: Do not put it in a shed yet. I need to check how hot it gets.
dialogue.vf.shed.s2.done: The casing survived this time. We can try an overnight burn.
research.vf.shed.s3.name: Keep the warmth
research.vf.shed.s3.objective: Choose a stove lining, then check the filing cabinet.
dialogue.vf.shed.s3.start: A thicker liner, or a little more coal. I can build either.
dialogue.vf.shed.s3.done: I have the measurements. The same fittings work in either size of shed.
research.vf.shed.s4.name: Through the night
research.vf.shed.s4.objective: Wait two nights, then check the stove record at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.shed.s4.start: Warm enough by day. Now to see if it lasts the night.
dialogue.vf.shed.s4.done: It stayed warm all night. Mom can build an agricultural shed now. Once it is built, choose heating at the filing cabinet and click the shed. The stove goes in straight away.

shed.vf.heat.description: Warm through every season. Grow crops here all year.
shed.vf.moisture.description: Water lines serve every rack in the room, even empty ones.
shed.vf.console.description: Tap the wall computer outside to check racks, store supplies and tend this shed. PC: right-click.
shed.vf.archive_guide: Choose a shed, then click an agricultural shed. With the materials ready, installation is immediate. Ordinary sheds cannot take these fittings.
shed.vf.exterior_guide: The computer is built into the outside wall, right of the door. Tap it; PC players can right-click.
shed.vf.host_only: Ask the farm owner to install it.
shed.vf.agricultural_only: This fitting needs an agricultural shed.
shed.vf.missing_building: That shed is no longer here.
shed.vf.still_building: Wait until the shed is finished.
shed.vf.not_learned: Study this plan at the lab first.
shed.vf.panel_scope: This panel covers this shed. Ask Robin to enlarge the room.
research.vf.moisture.name: Shed moisture lining
research.vf.moisture.description: Build water lines with fiber and clay, then connect the racks.
research.vf.console.name: Wall computer
research.vf.console.description: Check on a shed from beside its door.
research.vf.moisture.s1.name: Make a water line
research.vf.moisture.s1.objective: Submit fiber and clay for a trial water line.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s1.start: Pack the fiber tight. We do not want water seeping through the clay.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s1.done: Connected. Hook up that empty rack, too.
research.vf.moisture.s2.name: Stop the leak
research.vf.moisture.s2.objective: Submit fiber, then check the water line at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s2.start: Wait. It is still dripping. A little more fiber here.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s2.done: There. Leave it for two nights.
research.vf.moisture.s3.name: Check the water line
research.vf.moisture.s3.objective: Wait two nights, then check the water notes in the archive.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s3.start: Leave the watering can. See whether the empty rack dries out.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s3.done: Still wet. It works on soil racks and water troughs.
research.vf.moisture.s4.name: Connect the racks
research.vf.moisture.s4.objective: Pick up the lining plan at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s4.start: Same plans for a big shed. Same supplies.
dialogue.vf.moisture.s4.done: Plans are in the archive. Choose water lines, then your agricultural shed. Place a rack and it gets water right away.
research.vf.console.s1.name: A small screen
research.vf.console.s1.objective: Submit a battery pack and refined quartz for a test panel.
dialogue.vf.console.s1.start: I want the screen in the wall right of the door. You can check it from outside. No desk to squeeze into the room.
dialogue.vf.console.s1.done: It lights up. Hmm. The frame needs to be sturdier.
research.vf.console.s2.name: Keep the rain out
research.vf.console.s2.objective: Submit refined quartz and check the panel at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.console.s2.start: It needs to work in the rain. One more seal around here.
dialogue.vf.console.s2.done: Dry inside. The button is still moving too.
research.vf.console.s3.name: Find the wall space
research.vf.console.s3.objective: Check the outside-wall mounting plan at the filing cabinet.
dialogue.vf.console.s3.start: Right of the door. The frame sits in the timber so it stays out of your way. Leave it outside.
dialogue.vf.console.s3.done: It fits both shed sizes. Keep the screen clear of the door frame.#$b#It counts each tier. A full four-tier rack means four plants.
research.vf.console.s4.name: Try the computer
research.vf.console.s4.objective: Pick up the wall-computer plan at the research desk.
dialogue.vf.console.s4.start: Put seeds and fertilizer in the supply chest. A four-tier rack takes four seeds.#$b#Replacing its fertilizer takes four portions too. The old fertilizer is used up; JinKeLa stays on the rack.#$b#The screen lists the supplies in the chest. A button lights up when there is enough for the whole room.
dialogue.vf.console.s4.done: The plans are in the archive. Once installed, tap the computer outside, to the right of the door; PC players can right-click.#$b#The overview shows plant counts and growth. Use the rack map to find an individual rack.
shed.vf.console_installed_notice: Computer installed. Tap it outside, to the right of the door; PC players can right-click.

console.vf.footer_0: Heat allows all seasons. Water lines serve racks. Ask Robin for a larger room.

console.vf.footer_2: One item per layer. Old fertilizer is not returned. JinKeLa stays.
console.vf.box_hint: Use stored supplies on the racks in this shed.
console.vf.box_empty: No planting supplies in the chest.
console.vf.seed_unsuited: These seeds do not suit a rack.
console.vf.seed_untried: This crop has not been researched.
console.vf.already_done: Every suitable rack already has it.
console.vf.busy: The supply chest is in use. Wait a moment.
console.vf.stand_here: Stand in front of this shed's computer.
console.vf.refused: That did not work. Racks and supplies were restored.
console.vf.no_racks: There are no racks in this shed yet.
cleanup.vf.title: Clear trial racks
cleanup.vf.hint: Remove plants, keep racks. Seeds are not returned.
cleanup.vf.confirm: Clear this rack's plants? Seeds and saplings will not be returned. Select again to confirm.
cleanup.vf.done: Plant removed. The rack is ready for new seeds.
cleanup.vf.records_kept: Submitted supplies and recorded observations stay.
